{
  "up": "Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value
Join activities on activity_id
Join assays on assay_id
Join target_dictionary on tid
Left Join compound_structures on molregno
Filter activities.standard_relation = '='
Filter activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
Filter assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'
Filter target_dictionary.tid = 1681611
Filter target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
Filter target_dictionary.pref_name = 'Prolactin-releasing peptide receptor'
Sort by molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id
Limit 1000"
}
